text: You will carry out a titration to determine the concentration of a solution of potassium
manganate(VII), KMnO . Potassium manganate(VII) reacts with excess acidified potassium
iodide to produce iodine. This iodine is titrated with aqueous sodium thiosulfate.
FA 1 is aqueous potassium manganate(VII), KMnO .
